{{incomplete}} This is a list of manga samplers published by [[VIZ Media]] which feature [[Pokémon manga]] in them. ==Manga== ===The Electric Tale of Pikachu=== ====The Electric Tale of Pikachu Special Signature Edition==== {{main|The Electric Tale of Pikachu Special Signature Edition Red Version}} VIZ Media published two special sampler editions of [[The Electric Tale of Pikachu]] which were each released with a [[Pokémon Video Suitcase]]. The two volumes, red and blue, collect the first four chapters of the manga. ====VIZ Video samplers==== When episodes of {{aniseries|PTS}} were first released on [[List of English language Indigo League home video releases (Region 1)|home video]] by VIZ Media, some videos included samplers of the manga series [[The Electric Tale of Pikachu]]. The first of these samplers, released with the first video in the set, ''I Choose You! Pikachu!'', was actually released prior to the [[Electric Tale of Pikachu issue 1|first monthly issue]] of The Electric Tale of Pikachu and thus was a sneak peek at the manga before its release and therefore the first appearance of any Pokémon manga to English-speaking audiences. Samplers from the first two volumes, [[Electric Tale of Pikachu volume 1|The Electric Tale of Pikachu!]] and [[Electric Tale of Pikachu volume 2|Pikachu Shocks Back!]] are known to exist. The samplers do not include full versions of each chapter, rather, they are cut off part way through. {{MerchGallery | background={{colorschemelight|Kanto}} | border={{colorschemedark|Kanto}} | image1=ET01 sampler 1.png | caption1=Sampler of the chapter ''[[ET01|Pikachu, I See You!]]'' | image2=ET06 sampler 3.png | caption2=
Sampler of the chapter
''[[ET06|To Evolve or Not to Evolve, That Is the Question!]]''
| }} ===Pokémon Adventures=== ====San Diego Comic Con 2011 sampler==== A VIZ Media manga sampler was included in a {{DL|Pokémon manga merchandise|Pokémon Adventures|swag bag}} at the 2011 {{wp|San Diego Comic Con}}. The bag itself featured several manga characters from VIZ Media's series, including [[Pika]]. The book includes sample chapters of several VIZ Media licenses, including {{zw|The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (Manga)|The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time}}, {{wp|Mameshiba}}, and two different arcs of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga: Pokémon: Black and White (based on the magazine version of the {{MangaArc|Black & White}}) and Pokémon Adventures: Diamond and Pearl/Platinum (the {{MangaArc|Diamond & Pearl}}). The chapters featured are ''[[PS462|Choices]]'' and ''[[PS342|A Conk on Cranidos's Cranium]]''. {{MerchGallery | image1=VIZ Kids sampler 2011 cover.png | caption1=Cover artwork for the 2011 sampler, featuring characters from Pokémon Adventures | }} ====Free Comic Book Day 2015==== On {{wp|Free Comic Book Day}} 2015, VIZ Media released a sampler featuring the Pokémon Adventures manga. Unlike previous samplers, this features Pokémon Adventures only and no other licenses. This sampler contains the chapter ''[[PS549|An X-cuse to Come Out and Play]]'' from the {{MangaArc|X & Y}}, ''[[PS304|Swanky Showdown with Swalot]]'' from the {{MangaArc|Emerald}} and ''[[PS462|Choices]]'' from the {{MangaArc|Black & White}}. None of the three chapters are completely included in the sampler, each one is cut off part way through. {{MerchGallery | image1=FCBD 2015 sampler.png | caption1=Cover artwork for the 2015 sampler, featuring characters from the {{MangaArc|X & Y}} | }} ===Pokémon Pocket Comics: Black & White=== ====Free Comic Book Day 2013==== VIZ Media published a sampler in conjunction with {{wp|Free Comic Book Day}} in May 2013. The main feature of the sampler was {{wp|Uglydoll}} Comics, a series which was forthcoming at the time of publication. Also included were {{wp|Hello Kitty}}, {{wp|Mameshiba}} and a sample of [[Pokémon Pocket Comics: Black & White]] before it was released. ===Movie manga adaptations=== ====Movie 14 sampler==== When ''[[M14|Pokémon the Movie: White—Victini and Zekrom]]'' appeared in {{pmin|the United States|United States}} cinemas on December 3 and 4, 2011, attendees were given the opportunity to obtain a swag bag of promotional items. Included with this promotional set was a sampler of the {{MangaArc|Black & White|Pokémon: Black and White}} manga, containing part of the [[PS462|second chapter]] of the arc. As this sampler originated from VIZ Media's [[Pokémon Black and White volume 1|initial publication]] of the series, it is based on the magazine version. ==Ani-Manga== ===All That Pikachu! sampler=== A sampler of the [[All That Pikachu!]] graphic novel was included with the DVD release of ''[[M08|Lucario and the Mystery of Mew]]''. It included portions of both stories which appeared in the graphic novel - ''Pikachu's Vacation'' and ''Pikachu's Rescue Adventure''. {{MerchGallery | background={{colorschemelight|Pika}} | border={{colorschemedark|Pika}} | image1=All That Pikachu sampler.png | caption1=Cover of the All That Pikachu! sampler | }} ==Related articles== {{M08 navbox|collapse=yes}} {{M14 navbox|collapse=yes}} {{Project Manga notice}} [[Category:Manga]]
